# Pinned versions of everything CI installs (tox, lint, tests, docs).

# This is a pip *constraints* file, not an install list: CI sets
# PIP_CONSTRAINT to this path, so every `pip install` (including the ones
# tox runs inside its environments) is held to these exact versions.
# Dependabot keeps it current (see .github/dependabot.yml). The git
# dependencies in docs/src/requirements.txt can't be constrained here, so
# they are pinned to a commit there and must be bumped by hand.
